overview.title: AquaGrowth Lestari
overview.description: A professionally designed sustainable fish and shrimp farming program that uses modern technology to achieve optimal, high-quality harvests while offering promising investment opportunities in the aquaculture sector, which continues to grow alongside increasing global demand for animal protein.

objectives.0: Develop efficient and environmentally friendly fish and shrimp farming systems through modern technology and management practices.
objectives.1: Offer stable and profitable investment opportunities in aquaculture for individual and institutional investors.
objectives.2: Promote blue economy growth by making aquatic resources productive and sustainable.
objectives.3: Strengthen national food security and seafood exports through consistent production that meets export-quality standards.

partnership.title: Partnership Model
partnership.description: AquaGrowth creates collaboration opportunities between farmers and investors through a planned aquaculture ecosystem supported by technology and focused on results.

farmer.label: Path A
farmer.title: Farmers
farmer.description: Join the AquaGrowth program to develop aquaculture activities with operational support and technology.

eligibility.0: Own or manage a pond suitable for aquaculture activities.
eligibility.1: Be willing to follow the program's operational standards and guidance.
eligibility.2: Be willing to participate in monitoring and evaluation throughout the farming cycle.

investor.label: Path B
investor.title: Investors
investor.description: Participate in aquaculture operational funding according to the available investment packages and partnership terms.

eligibility.0: Choose an available investment package and location.
eligibility.1: Understand the partnership terms, period, and profit-sharing arrangement.
eligibility.2: Complete the administrative and funding process according to the agreement.

flow.description: From package selection to profit distribution, each stage follows the partnership process and aquaculture cycle.

intro.title: Plan Your Cultivation
intro.description: Select an aerator and enter your cultivation data to estimate biomass, oxygen requirements, and equipment quantities based on the available parameters.

aerator.description: Select the equipment you want to use.

mini.name: Mini Aerator
mini.subtitle: For small-scale ponds
mini.description: A mini aerator option for tilapia farming in smaller ponds.
mini.note: Reference data for tilapia grow-out from the technical materials.

brush.name: Brush Aerator
brush.subtitle: For fish grow-out
brush.description: A brush aerator installed according to the applicable SOP to support higher-biomass farming.
brush.note: Biomass capacity is based on the range provided in the technical materials.

brushWeighted.name: Brush + Weight
brushWeighted.subtitle: Weighted configuration
brushWeighted.description: A brush aerator with an added weight for a configuration with a higher reference biomass capacity.
brushWeighted.note: Biomass capacity is based on the range provided in the technical materials.

aerator.oxygenOutput: O₂ output listed in the materials
aerator.capacityNote: Capacity figures are based on the supplied materials and must be verified before being used as operational recommendations.

form.title: Cultivation Data
form.description: Enter data that reflects your pond conditions.
form.pondModeDescription: Calculate biomass from pond and fish data.
form.biomassModeDescription: Enter the target total fish biomass.

area.label: Pond area
area.hint: Total area of the pond being used.

density.label: Stocking density
density.hint: Number of fish per square meter.

averageWeight.label: Average fish weight
averageWeight.hint: Average fish weight at the cultivation stage being calculated.

targetBiomass.label: Target fish biomass
targetBiomass.hint: Enter the estimated total weight of fish to be supported.

form.validation: Enter valid numbers greater than zero in all required fields.

result.title: Calculation Summary
result.heading: Cultivation Results
result.description: Estimates based on your inputs and the equipment capacity references.
result.emptyDescription: Choose an aerator, complete the cultivation data, and select calculate to view the simulation results.
result.basedOnCapacity: Based on a reference capacity of {capacity} kg of biomass per unit.
result.oxygenFormula: Based on the reference value of 700 mg O₂/kg/hour from the supplied materials.
result.technicalValidationDescription: This is an initial mathematical estimate, not a finalized equipment recommendation. Actual capacity, pond configuration, and safety factors must be confirmed by the technical team.

technicalNotes.title: Calculation Notes
technicalNotes.biomass: Biomass is calculated by multiplying the number of fish by their average weight.
technicalNotes.devices: The estimated number of units is rounded up using the lower bound of the biomass capacity range in the supplied materials.
technicalNotes.oxygen: Oxygen requirements are calculated using the reference value of 700 mg O₂/kg/hour from the supplied materials.
technicalNotes.limitations: The calculation does not yet account for safety factors, water conditions, pond depth, oxygen distribution, or the actual aerator configuration.
technicalNotes.general: The calculation uses reference data from the Mini Aerator, Brush Aerator, and Brush + Weight materials. Oxygen output and operating capacity still require verification.
technicalNotes.outputDisclaimer: Oxygen output figures are shown as provided in the supplied materials and have not been verified against the equipment specifications.
